english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term when lamb means meat used as food.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for sheep meat used as food, including the meat of adult sheep.

examples.english: We’re having lamb in our hot pot tonight.
examples.traditional: 我哋今晚打邊爐食羊肉。
